sections.title: Above the fold
sections.guide: One headline: the service and the city, exactly as the ads say it. Under it the offer in one line and the phone as a tap-to-call button. One button only: Call, with Book online beside it when the practice takes online bookings. The star rating and review count here only when they are real.
sections.example: Invisalign in Palo Alto — free consultation. Call (650) 555-0100.

sections.title: Why this practice
sections.guide: Three short reasons taken from the practice's own facts: years in practice, same-week appointments, insurance taken, the dentist's name. Real reviews with the reviewer's first name and the source; never a review the practice did not receive.
sections.example: Same-week appointments · Most PPO plans accepted · 14 years in Palo Alto

sections.title: What the visit is like
sections.guide: Three or four plain sentences on the service: what happens at the first visit, how long it takes, what it costs or that the consultation is free. No promises about results.
sections.example: Your first visit is a 45-minute consultation. We scan your teeth, show you the plan and give you a price before anything starts.

sections.title: Request a call
sections.guide: Name, phone, the service, a preferred time. Nothing about health, symptoms or insurance details in the form. One line under the button saying the practice calls back within business hours.
sections.example: We call back within one business day.

sections.title: Questions people ask
sections.guide: Four to six questions with one-paragraph answers: what the first visit costs, whether the plan is accepted, how long treatment takes, whether it hurts (answer honestly, no 'painless'), parking.
sections.example: Do you take my insurance? We accept most PPO plans; bring your card and we check before the visit.

sections.title: Hours and where
sections.guide: Opening hours, the address with a map link, the phone again.

sections.title: Footer
sections.guide: The practice's name, a Terms link, the Privacy notice link (required when the page has a form), the practice's phone or e-mail, and the required professional line for the state when there is one.

form_rules: Never ask a health question, a symptom or a diagnosis in the form.
Do not ask for insurance numbers.
Say when the practice calls back.

required_lines.when: Texas, unless the dentist is a recognised specialist

required_lines.text: The fee shown is the minimum fee only
required_lines.when: Florida, next to any advertised fee
